metrics.name: cnpg_otel_query_runs_total

metrics.description: Duration of the last run of a query.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_query_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.description: Unix time of the last run of a query that returned rows (outcome ok).

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_query_interval_seconds
metrics.description: Effective run interval of a query.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_series
metrics.description: Series currently held for export.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_config_loads_total

metrics.description: Duplicate query names found while loading a source.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_config_info
metrics.description: Always 1; the active configuration generation and hash are attributes.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_check
metrics.description: 1 if a live check holds, 0 otherwise, from the last facts round (pg_monitor, read_only, track_io_timing, track_wal_io_timing, track_functions, superuser). read_only checks the engine's transactions, so it is 1 while they run read-only (transaction_read_only=on). superuser is 1 while the session role is a superuser; the sidecar then runs no query.

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_exports_total
metrics.description: Export operations by outcome (ok, error, skipped).

metrics.name: cnpg_otel_last_export_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.description: Unix time of the last successful export.

metrics.name: otel.sdk.exporter.metric_data_point.exported
metrics.description: Data points an export operation sent; rejected points count as failed with error.type=rejected. error.type is set only on failure.

metrics.name: otel.sdk.exporter.operation.duration
metrics.description: Duration of an export operation after the last retry, in a single bucket. error.type is set only on failure, http.response.status_code only for HTTP.

metrics.name: cnpg_collector_collections_total

metrics.name: cnpg_collector_nodes_used
metrics.description: NodesUsed represents the count of distinct nodes accommodating the instances. A value of '-1' suggests that the metric is not available. A value of '1' suggests that all instances are hosted on a single node, implying the absence of High Availability (HA). Ideally this value should match the number of instances in the cluster.
